say: Next: A.I., deeper — a model registry, your own keys, and an orchestrator that dispatches work across live sessions. Workflow pulses — scheduled audits that walk your tree and file their reports as tiles. Contract fulfillment — a protocol where remote participants can ask your hive for work and receive signed results. And the native Windows client — already running, and held to the same protocol by conformance vectors generated from the reference implementation. One contract, many shells.
